content.title: Who Is Mike Vrabel's Wife? All About Jen Vrabel and Her Relationship with the Patriots Coach
content.text: NEED TO KNOW New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel met his wife, Jen Vrabel, when they were student-athletes at Ohio State UniversityMike and Jen married in 1999The former NFL player and his wife share two sons Mike Vrabel and his wife, Jen Vrabel, have been married for over two decades. The New England Patriots head coach and the NFL reporter met at Ohio State University, where Jen noticed Mike in class and got his number through their professor, according to The Tennessean. After connecting, the student-athletes dated, and Jen was still in school when the Pittsburgh Steelers drafted Mike in the 1997 draft. The following year, Jen graduated with a bachelor's degree in dental hygiene, and by 1999, she and Mike were married. Since then, the pair have welcomed two children. On the field, Mike's professional football career spanned over a decade, earning accolades with three different teams, until he retired in 2011. Afterward, the Super Bowl-winning player went on to coach at his alma mater. Mike credited his wife for challenging him “to get into the NFL after spending some time at Ohio State.” More recently, The New York Times reported on April 11 that NFL reporter Dianna Russini, who is also married, is under investigation by her employer, The Athletic, after she and Mike were seen holding hands in a series of photos published by Page Six on April 7. The same day the snapshots were published, Mike told the New York Post that the photos "show a completely innocent interaction, and any suggestion otherwise is laughable. This doesn’t deserve any further response." So who is Mike Vrabel's wife? Here’s everything to know about Jen Vrabel. She was a student-athlete at the Ohio State University Mike Vrabel and his wife Jen Vrabel in January 2015. Mike Vrabel/X Both Mike and Jen attended Ohio State University, although they didn't earn their diplomas at the same time. She graduated from the Big Ten School in 1998 with a bachelor’s degree in dental hygiene, according to an Ohio State Buckeyes press release. Meanwhile, he returned to the college in 2004 to earn his bachelor’s degree in exercise science. "Ohio State has had a great impact on the lives of my wife and me," the NFL coach said in 2006. Like her husband, Jen was a college athlete. While Mike played football, she was on the school's volleyball team from 1993 to 1996. According to the Ohio State Buckeyes website, she was a two-time AVCA All-District selection, in addition to a two-time All-Big Ten and Academic All-Big Ten honoree. She made the first move after seeing Mike in class Mike Vrabel and his wife Jen Vrabel in May 2017. Mike Vrabel/X Jen first noticed Mike in their freshman lecture class on time management, according to a 2018 interview with The Tennessean. She told the outlet that he sat at the front of the classroom and always talked. Eventually, she “found him funny enough to ask the professor for his phone number,” and they “quickly became inseparable.” Mike was drafted to the NFL the year before Jen graduated from Ohio State. The Steelers selected the football player in the third round of the 1997 NFL Draft. They have been married for over 25 years While Mike and Jen haven't revealed many details about their relationship, they wed in 1999. The pair celebrated 25 years of marriage in 2024 with a 10-day trip to Italy, which The New York Times described as the coach’s “first true vacation ... maybe ever.” Related Stories She and Mike share two sons New England Patriots Mike Vrabel and son Tyler Vrabel celebrate at the 2004 Super Bowl on February 1, 2004. John Biever/Sports Illustrated via Getty Mike and Jen welcomed their first son Tyler on June 24, 2000. Speaking to the Atlanta Falcons in 2023, Tyler recalled celebrating with his dad and the rest of the Patriots team when they won the 2004 Super Bowl against the Carolina Panthers. The father and son were photographed together on the field, signaling No. 1 with their hands. Mike and Jen grew their family again with the birth of their son Carter on Nov. 20, 2001. Years later, the NFL star revealed that he missed the special moment. “I'm not proud to say this, but I'm just going to tell you about my wife. She gave birth to Carter, I missed it, I was at practice, she was in Ohio,” Mike said at a 2018 press conference. “He came early, he flipped, they had to take her. I showed up four hours late because I was playing football and she was having a baby.” Naturally, the boys grew up surrounded by football. "They've been around the NFL locker room since they've been born," he added at the event. Since then, the couple's kids have followed in their athletic footsteps. In 2017, Tyler committed to Boston College, where he was an offensive tackle. Five years later, he was added to the Atlanta Falcons’ practice squad, per an announcement. Today, Tyler is an assistant coach for Boston College's football team. Meanwhile, Carter committed to play baseball at Wabash Valley College and later played at Volunteer State Community College and Tennessee Tech. 0 seconds of 45 secondsVolume 0% Who Is Anne Hathaway's Husband? 3 Things to Know About Adam Shulman
